I am old now, 59 years, and I have farmed this land my whole life without school. This small maize plot is only a piece of my land, but maize feeds my family so I must care for it well. I will buy some DAP and urea from the cooperative if they bring it in time, though the plot is small so I do not need much. I will put manure from my cattle on it too, use the seed I saved from last year because the improved seed is expensive and not always available here, and my wife and sons will help me weed — I cannot afford to hire people for such a small plot.
